findings.title: Targets that interpolate to an empty expression are still executed
findings.body: The expression-presence filter runs before applyTemplateVariables. A target such as an optional query variable whose value resolves to an empty string therefore remains in the split groups and is passed to Loki with an empty expr, which can make an otherwise valid grouped request fail. The same pre-interpolation filtering order was added to shardQuerySplitting.ts:50; both entry points should filter out empty expressions after interpolation (while still skipping hidden targets before it).

findings.title: Sharded queries now apply template processing once per shard batch after already processing it
findings.body: This expands each target before shard discovery, but the resulting targets are later put into subRequest while retaining request.scopedVars and request.filters. runSplitQuery then calls applyTemplateVariables again for every shard group at querySplitting.ts:299. Template replacement is not generally idempotent: a literal value produced by the first expansion that contains a variable token can be expanded on the second pass, and ad-hoc filter rewriting is also rerun on the already rewritten selector. Consequently the final query can depend on how many shard groups were created. Preserve the initially interpolated targets for the inner splitter without reapplying templates, or explicitly mark/clear the already-consumed interpolation inputs.
